accessibility.remove-card: Take the card out of the deck

button.clone-deck: Take it over as my own

description.clone-deck: The deck is filed under this name among your own. It starts out private, and the owner's tags stay with them.
description.bracket-unchecked: Two-card combos are checked by the advisor, not by this list.
description.colors: The commander normally decides which colors the deck may play. Some cards allow another one on top, which is what this is for.
description.create-url: Optional. The deck is filed straight in from Moxfield, Archidekt, or a shared Planarium link. Pasting a list is an action on the deck afterwards.
description.decks: Every deck is built for a format. What that format asks for stands above the list as a remark, nothing is locked.
description.delete-deck: “{{name}}” and every card in it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
description.delete-deck-cards: This deck holds {{count}} cards from your collection.
description.delete-folder: The folder goes; the decks in it stay and end up without a folder.
description.delete-menu: The deck and every card in it
description.delete-tag: The tag comes off every card it sits on.
description.description: The game plan, notes on the deck, whatever you want.
description.dissolve-menu: Cards go back into the collections they came from
description.export: One line per card. Moxfield, Archidekt and Arena read this as it is.
description.export-with-printing: Off means quantity and name only, no set or collector number. A card sleeved from several printings becomes one line.
description.folders: Folders are your own shelves for decks. A deck lies in at most one of them.
description.format: Decides what is checked: deck size, copies, commander.
description.hand-distribution: Exactly that many lands among the first seven cards.
description.hand-mulliganed: Exactly that many lands in the hand that is kept, when a first hand outside two to four lands goes back for free.
description.import: One line per card, the way Arena, MTGO, Moxfield and Archidekt write them. Headings like “Sideboard” or “Commander” are recognised; without them the first blank line starts the sideboard.
description.import-menu: A decklist, or a link from Moxfield or Archidekt
description.import-url: A link to a deck on Moxfield, Archidekt, or a deck shared from Planarium.
description.mana-curve: Lands excluded, everything from 7 pooled together.
description.mana-sources: Above what the spells ask for, below what the deck can produce. Lands, rocks and creatures count the same.
description.no-cards: Search on the left and put a card into the deck.
description.no-cards-found: No card in the deck matches this search.
description.no-decks: Build a deck to put cards into.
description.no-decks-found: No deck goes by that name and no commander is called that.
description.no-statistics: Put cards into the deck and this says what it is made of.
description.opening-colors: At least one source of each color in the opening hand.
description.opening-hand: {{lands}} lands in {{cards}} cards, counted exactly rather than simulated.
description.pips: Coloured mana symbols in the costs. Hybrids count for both colours.
description.print-proxies: Open the deck in the proxy printer
description.printing-none-owned: No printing of this card is in your collections.
description.quick-tag: Tag the card under the pointer
description.remove-card: “{{name}}” will be taken out of the deck.
description.share-link: Anyone holding this link can see the deck with every card in it.
description.share-link-dead: This link does not work any more. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.
description.shared-empty: There are no cards in this deck.
description.tag-keys: The number beside a tag is the key that puts it on the card under the pointer.
description.tag-names: Several at once: separate the names with commas.
description.tag-statistics: What the deck brings as a plan. A card with several tags counts under each of them, so the shares add up past the deck.
description.tags: Tags sort a deck by plan rather than by card type: ramp, removal, draw. A global tag follows the card through every deck, printing and artwork; a local one only applies to the selected deck slot.
description.thin-support: Cards whose colors are likely missing by the turn their mana value asks for.
description.visibility-private: Only you can see the deck.
description.visibility-unlisted: Anyone with the link can see it, nobody else.

label.colors-follow-commander: Take the colors from the commander
label.has-remark: There is a remark on this card
label.import-resolving: Looking the cards up in the catalog
label.name: Name
label.violation-commander: {{have}} in the command zone, allowed are {{min}} to {{max}}
label.violation-extra-turns_one: This bracket plays no extra turns: {{cards}}
label.violation-extra-turns_other: This bracket plays no extra turns ({{count}}): {{cards}}
label.violation-mass-land-denial_one: This bracket plays no mass land denial: {{cards}}
label.violation-mass-land-denial_other: This bracket plays no mass land denial ({{count}}): {{cards}}

toast.import-nothing: None of the cards could be found in the catalog.
toast.not-a-card-link: That was not a Scryfall card link.
toast.not-a-commander: This card cannot be a commander.
toast.unknown-card-link: Scryfall does not know that card.
